arxiv-2111-01779.title: Quantum signatures in nonlinear gravitational waves
arxiv-2111-01779.creator: Thiago Guerreiro, Francesco Coradeschi, Antonia Micol Frassino, Jennifer Rittenhouse West, Enrico Junior Schioppa
arxiv-2111-01779.description: Abstract The effective quantum field theory description of gravity, despite its non-renormalizability, allows for predictions beyond classical general relativity. As we enter the age of gravitational wave astronomy, an important and timely question is whether measurable quantum predictions that depart from classical gravity, analogous to quantum optics effects which cannot be explained by classical electrodynamics, can be found.

arxiv-2305-16785.title: Nonlinear saturation of resistive tearing modes in a cylindrical tokamak with and without solving the dynamics
arxiv-2305-16785.creator: J. Loizu, D. Bonfiglio
arxiv-2305-16785.description: Abstract We show that the saturation of resistive tearing modes in a cylindrical tokamak, as well as the corresponding island width, can be directly calculated with an MHD equilibrium code without solving the dynamics and without considering resistivity. The results are compared to initial value resistive MHD simulations and to an analytical nonlinear theory.

arxiv-2306-08288.title: System Information Decomposition
arxiv-2306-08288.creator: Aobo Lyu*, Bing Yuan, Ou Deng, Mingzhe Yang, Jiang Zhang*
arxiv-2306-08288.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aobo Lyu*, Bing Yuan, Ou Deng, Mingzhe Yang, Jiang Zhang*. To characterize the complex higher-order interactions among variables within a system, this study introduces a novel framework, termed System Information Decomposition (SID), aimed at decomposing the information entropy of variables into information atoms based on their interrelations.

arxiv-2408-06625.title: DePatch: Towards Robust Adversarial Patch for Evading Person Detectors in the Real World
arxiv-2408-06625.creator: Jikang Cheng, Ying Zhang, Zhongyuan Wang, Zou Qin, Chen Li
arxiv-2408-06625.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jikang Cheng, Ying Zhang, Zhongyuan Wang, Zou Qin, Chen Li. Recent years have seen an increasing interest in physical adversarial attacks, which aim to craft deployable patterns for deceiving deep neural networks, especially for person detectors. However, the adversarial patterns of existing patch-based attacks heavily suffer from the self-coupling issue, where a degradation, caused by physical transformations, in any small patch segment can result in a complete adversarial dysfunction, leading to poor robustness in the complex real world.

arxiv-2509-03688.title: The reverse mathematics of bounded Ramsey’s theorem for pairs
arxiv-2509-03688.creator: Quentin Le Houérou, Ludovic Patey
arxiv-2509-03688.description: Abstract In this article, we study a degenerate version of Ramsey’s theorem for pairs and two colors ( 𝖱𝖳 2 2 \mathsf{RT}^{2}_{2} ), in which the homogeneous sets for color 1 are of bounded size. By 𝖱𝖳 2 2 \mathsf{RT}^{2}_{2} , it follows that every such coloring admits an infinite homogeneous set for color 0.

arxiv-2509-16857.title: ShadowServe: Interference-Free KV Cache Fetching for Distributed Prefix Caching
arxiv-2509-16857.creator: Xingyu Xiang Raj Joshi Yuhan Liu Jiayi Yao Chenxingyu Zhao, Junchen Jiang Yang Zhou Eddie Kohler Minlan Yu
arxiv-2509-16857.description: Abstract Distributed prefix caching accelerates long-context LLM serving by reusing KV cache entries for common context prefixes. However, KV cache fetches can become a bottleneck when network bandwidth is limited. Compression mitigates the bandwidth issue, but can degrade overall performance when decompression interferes with model computation. We present ShadowServe, the first SmartNIC-accelerated, interference-free prefix caching system for LLM serving.

arxiv-2510-01983.title: Digital quantum simulation of many-body localization crossover in a disordered kicked Ising model
arxiv-2510-01983.creator: Tomoya Hayata, Kazuhiro Seki, Seiji Yunoki
arxiv-2510-01983.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tomoya Hayata, Kazuhiro Seki, Seiji Yunoki. Simulating nonequilibrium dynamics of quantum many-body systems is one of the most promising applications of quantum computers. However, a faithful digital quantum simulation of the Hamiltonian evolution is very challenging in the present noisy quantum devices. Instead, nonequilibrium dynamics under the Floquet evolution realized by the Trotter decomposition of the Hamiltonian evolution with a large Trotter step size is considered to be a suitable problem for simulating in the present or near-term quantum devices.

arxiv-2512-10446.title: Long memory network time series
arxiv-2512-10446.creator: Chiara Boetti, Matthew A. Nunes, Marina I. Knight
arxiv-2512-10446.description: Abstract Many scientific areas, from computer science to the environmental sciences and finance, give rise to multivariate time series which exhibit long memory, or loosely put, a slow decay in their autocorrelation structure. Efficient modelling and estimation in such settings is key for a number of analysis tasks, such as accurate prediction.

pmc-11462903.title: Assessing public trust in road traffic injuries prevention policies in Iran: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11462903.creator: Esmail Ezzati, Mohammad Saadati, Deniz Naghibi, Mehran Sardareh, Reza Ali Akbari Khoei, Saber Azami-Aghdash
pmc-11462903.description: Introduction and objectiveRoad Traffic Injuries (RTIs) represent the predominant cause of morbidity and mortality globally. Thus, impactful interventions and trustworthy authorities are imperative to mitigate traffic accidents. The present study seeks to assess public trust in traffic accident diminution policies and measures within the country of Iran.MethodThis cross-sectional study utilized a questionnaire comprising 31 questions distributed across eight dimensions.

pmc-11582775.title: Improve the fiber structure and texture properties of plant-based meat analogues by adjusting the ratio of soy protein isolate (SPI) to wheat gluten (WG)
pmc-11582775.creator: Lianzhou Jiang, Hongyang Zhang, Jiayu Zhang, Sibo Liu, Yachao Tian, Tianfu Cheng, Zengwang Guo, Zhongjiang Wang
pmc-11582775.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The effects of the ratio change of SPI and WG (11: 1, 10: 2, 9: 3, 8: 4, 7: 5, 6: 6 and 5: 7) on the product characteristics of plant-based meat analogues (PBMAs) were investigated. The results show that the addition of WG significantly reduces the hardness and chewiness of PBMAs, but significantly improves the springiness and brightness of PBMAs. When the ratio of SPI to WG is 9: 3, PBMAs has the best fiber structure, storage modulus and apparent viscosity.

pmc-11645911.title: O077 Nocturia as a Marker for Cardiovascular Risk in Obstructive Sleep Apnoea
pmc-11645911.creator: S Graffen, Y Bin, K Kairaitis, J Wheatley, B Yee, A Piper, P Cistulli
pmc-11645911.description: BackgroundObstructive Sleep Apnoea (OSA) is highly prevalent and is associated with cardiovascular (CV) risk. Factors beyond AHI alone appear to influence this risk. Clinical biomarkers of cardiovascular risk in OSA are needed to assist clinicians in making treatment decisions. Nocturia is a commonly reported symptom in OSA. This study aims to assess the association between nocturia and cardiovascular risk.

pmc-11677433.title: Resynthesis of Damaged Fe-S Cluster Proteins Protects Aspergillus fumigatus Against Oxidative Stress in the Absence of Mn-Superoxide Dismutase
pmc-11677433.creator: Klaudia Pákozdi, Károly Antal, Kitti Pázmándi, Márton Miskei, Zsuzsa Szabó, István Pócsi, Tamás Emri, Praveen Juvvadi
pmc-11677433.description: The importance of manganese superoxide dismutase (Mn-SOD), an evolutionarily ancient metalloenzyme that maintains the integrity and function of mitochondria, was studied in oxidative stress-treated Aspergillus fumigatus cultures. Deletion of the Mn-SOD gene (sodB) increased both the menadione sodium bisulfite (MSB)-elicited oxidative stress and the deferiprone (DFP)-induced iron limitation stress sensitivity of the strain.

pmc-13485498.creator: Yahya Argobi, Faisal Tobeigei, Faris I. Alasiri
pmc-13485498.description: BackgroundEosinophilic Fasciitis (EF) is a rare immune-mediated fibrosing disorder of the fascia. Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed oncologic therapy but may precipitate immune-related Adverse Events (irAEs), including dermatologic and rheumatologic manifestations.
